snippet.title: TI-99/4A Pinball 99 - beta version
snippet.description:
First beta version of my pinball game. Runs from ROM cartridge on a TI-99/4A with 32K memory expansion. The video is recorded from https://js99er.net.

https://atariage.com/forums/topic/336079-pinball-99/
